title: Zapata Quantum, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-15
summary: Zapata Quantum, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 15, 2026 reporting the sale of 3,750 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock and warrants to purchase 4,270,098 shares of common stock to accredited investors on April 9 and April 14, 2026, for gross proceeds of $3,750,000. The company intends to use the net proceeds for working capital and general corporate purposes.
key_points: On April 9 and April 14, 2026, Zapata Quantum sold 3,750 shares of Series D Convertible Preferred Stock with warrants to purchase 4,270,098 common shares.
Gross proceeds from the two sales totaled $3,750,000.

The company has a total offering of up to 15,000 shares of Series D (convertible into 34,160,784 common shares) and warrants for up to 17,080,392 shares for potential total gross proceeds of up to $15,000,000.
Warrant coverage is 50% on an as-converted basis.
Craig-Hallum Capital Group acted as lead placement agent; Odeon Capital Group acted as co-lead placement agent.
Placement agent compensation includes 2% warrant coverage on Series D conversion shares and a 6% cash fee on gross proceeds.
The transaction was exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act and Rule 506(b).
